title: 5.3.1 Introducing Groups
description: Groups let you treat many sprites as one. Create, configure, and iterate a Group.

steps.title: Make a Group
steps.instructions: stars = new Group(); — a Group is a sprite factory + a container.
hints: Groups inherit from Array — use stars.length, for..of, filter, etc.

steps.title: Set defaults on the Group
steps.instructions: stars.color = 'yellow'; stars.diameter = 10; — every sprite added to the group starts with these.
hints: Set defaults once rather than per-sprite.

steps.title: Spawn sprites into the Group
steps.instructions: In update(), every so often call new stars.Sprite(randomX, 0) — note capital-S Sprite on the group.
hints: Use world.frameCount % 20 === 0 to spawn every 20 frames.

steps.title: Remove sprites that leave the screen
steps.instructions: for each sprite in the group: if sprite.y > height + 50, sprite.remove(). Otherwise your sketch slows to a crawl.

requirements.title: Spawn into the Group
requirements.description: Use groupName.Sprite(...) to spawn a sprite in the group

requirements.title: Group default
requirements.description: Set a property on the Group itself (e.g. .color, .diameter)
